case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Coffee Clip Exact URL Ending
tests: Checks an exact case-sensitive URL rendered legibly on a timed end card rather than merely mentioned in the reply.

faults.what: The end card contains a large white rectangle and a gray horizontal band rather than a plain black background.
The URL is oversized and clipped at both frame edges, hiding its beginning and ending.

judge.summary: The coffee pour looks appropriate, but the end card has the wrong background and a severely cropped URL.

must_haves.item: The first approximately 5 seconds show a close-up of coffee visibly pouring into a ceramic cup.
must_haves.why: The early frames show a clear coffee stream entering a ceramic cup, followed by the end card at 5 seconds.

must_haves.item: The final approximately 3 seconds are a plain black end card.
must_haves.why: Both end-card samples show a large white panel and gray band within black margins.

must_haves.item: The end card reads exactly 'https://example.com/Go?ref=June', preserving uppercase G and J, the colon, slashes, question mark and equals sign.
must_haves.why: Only the middle portion is readable; the beginning and ending are cropped, so the complete required URL is not displayed.

must_haves.item: The URL is centered in white on one line, fully inside the frame and readable throughout the end card.
must_haves.why: The text is white and on one line near the center, but extends beyond both sides of the frame in both samples.

must_haves.item: No other written text appears anywhere in the video.
must_haves.why: No writing other than the cropped URL appears in the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is silent, 9:16 and approximately 8 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are approximately 9:16 and the stated duration is 8 seconds, but the supplied audio report identifies speech, despite an extremely low reported peak of -91 dB.
